latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of local-bookmark-librarian.

- Organize and deduplicate local bookmark or link exports.
- Generate themed indexes and maintenance recommendations.
- Prioritize overview drafts, duplicate detection, topic folders, and low-value links.
- Clearly state boundaries: does not modify browser configs or delete links without confirmation.
- Supports Python script execution if available; otherwise, produces results based on local templates/specs.
- Designed for safe, reviewable, and user-controlled bookmark management.
